baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired verbs يَبْسُطُ and يَقْدِرُ govern الرِّزْق under رَبَّكَ and are closed by خَبِيرًا بَصِيرًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship as repair and completion administers an apportioned benefit through breadth and narrow measure. Knowledge of inward reality and outward condition makes the variation calibrated stewardship rather than a transparent ranking of recipients.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship the governing frame of allocation.
Breadth and increase supply the expansive phase.
An apportioned gift identifies provision as an assigned benefit.
Narrowing to a small measure supplies the counter-movement to expansion.
Knowledge of inner realities supplies access to hidden conditions.
Direct sight supplies knowledge of each servant's outward state.

changed_reading.before: Provision simply varies by divine will.
changed_reading.after: Provision is an apportioned benefit widened or narrowed by an informed caretaker who knows hidden need and visible condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The singular لِمَن يَشَاءُ is followed by بِعِبَادِهِ and two epistemic predicates.
baseline_models.mechanism: Intentional willing selects a person, while qadr as fitting a thing to its proper measure individualizes the allocation. Inward and outward discernment resist treating one visible quantity as the same good for everyone.

activation_trace.role: Will intentionally related to an outcome supplies purposive selection rather than accident.
Agreement with a proper measure supplies person-specific fitting rather than quantity alone.
Knowledge of the interior supplies information unavailable from visible wealth.
Discernment of the heart supplies evaluative sight beyond surface comparison.

changed_reading.before: For whomever He wills can sound like opaque preference.
changed_reading.after: The relative clause marks individualized fitting by one who discerns each servant's inward and outward condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The family sequence turns calibration into care across changing dependency: parents nourish a small child, the grown child meets their age with mercy, and the Lord knows inward states. Expansion and restriction can be heard as care adjusted over a life course, not abandonment when capacity contracts.

activation_trace.role: Repair and gradual completion anchor the focus in sustained care.
Tender mercy supplies the manner in which dependency is answered.
Feeding and growth make upbringing a concrete model of changing provision.
Disclosure to the knower strengthens the claim that calibration rests on genuine knowledge.

structural_cues: 17:23-25 reverses care from parents nurturing infancy to a grown child serving their old age while repeating lordship and inward knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal care, nourishment, mercy, and knowledge; I infer that these relations model calibration across changing dependency. A live alternative is that the family sequence exemplifies human duty without specifying why provision varies.

changed_reading.before: Expansion and restriction describe changing material allotments.
changed_reading.after: They also describe life-course care adjusted as dependence and capacity change while the relation of care persists.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pre-focus commands establish claims that must be given, then exclude both immobilized withholding and total hand-extension ending in depletion. The focus pair locates human generosity inside a larger economy of measured capacity rather than authorizing either extreme.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate estimation supplies the focus-side principle governing an open hand.
A binding entitlement prevents measured giving from becoming optional charity.
Wasteful dispersal of wealth supplies one failed mode of extension.
A collar binding a limb materializes an incapacitated giving hand.
Full release of the hand connects spending directly to the focus verb of expansion.
Exhausted capacity supplies the endpoint of unbounded extension.

structural_cues: 17:29 immediately precedes the focus and repeats ب س ط twice in the hand image; 17:26 places an owed right before the prohibition of waste.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an owed claim, a bound hand, total extension, and exhaustion; I infer that divine expansion-and-measure frames responsible human mediation without equating human and divine agency. Alternatively, 17:30 may only explain fluctuating capacity.

changed_reading.before: The verse explains why resources may be broad or narrow.
changed_reading.after: It also situates the giver's hand between binding and depletion: claims remain due, but generosity works within measured capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah exposes a lethal inference from anticipated poverty: an emptied hand is projected forward and a dependent is erased. Its inclusive provision formula interrupts that forecast. Constriction is a limit to navigate, not evidence that another life has no allotted share.

activation_trace.role: A reduced measure supplies the real pressure that scarcity fear misreads as final absence.
Children as offspring make future dependents the objects of the scarcity decision.
Fear with apprehensive weight supplies the affective engine of the false forecast.
A hand stripped of wealth gives the feared condition its bodily economic image.
The apportioned gift extended to children and adults counters a closed zero-sum projection.
Taking life supplies the irreversible result of treating scarcity as certain.

structural_cues: 17:31 follows the focus immediately, repeats the provision root, and names the children before the addressed adults.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fear of an emptied hand, killing, and provision for both generations; I infer that present constriction cannot settle another person's future share. A live alternative is that the prohibition remains specific to killing.

changed_reading.before: Constriction is a condition within divine distribution.
changed_reading.after: Constriction cannot become a zero-sum verdict against dependents, whose possible share exceeds the fearful agent's knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence from an orphan's exposed property to full measure, weight, and a straight balance translates qadr from generic limitation into fiduciary exactness. Provision is not only received quantity; it is a trust whose shares and transfers must be completed without deficit.

activation_trace.role: A quantity brought to its defining limit supplies the metrological anchor.
Separation from a caretaker supplies the vulnerable owner for whom stewardship matters.
Completion without deficiency supplies the quality required of the trust.
Measuring food supplies the concrete operation of assigning quantity.
The balance of justice turns quantity into equitable relation.
Straightness and equilibrium supply the target state of measured exchange.

structural_cues: 17:34-35 moves from guarding vulnerable wealth to public operations and instruments of exact measure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vulnerable ownership, completion, measure, weight, and straightness; I infer that qadr resonates as a fiduciary norm for handling provision. Alternatively, divine apportionment and commercial measurement may remain analogous but separate.

changed_reading.before: Qadr names the narrowing side of divine provision.
changed_reading.after: Qadr also sounds as exact allotment, making provision a trust to transfer and weigh without concealed loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus attributes inward knowledge and sight to the allocator; 17:36 forbids following what one does not know and makes human sight and heart answerable. The contrast blocks observers from turning visible abundance or scarcity into confident judgments about a servant's worth.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge of inner reality gives the allocator access unavailable to spectators.
Heart-discernment makes the closing predicate evaluative rather than merely optical.
Following a trace images conclusions drawn from partial outward evidence.
Real disclosure to a knower supplies the threshold unsupported judgment fails.
Human eyesight supplies a limited faculty explicitly placed under questioning.
The inward heart supplies the center that turns perception into judgment.
Questioning makes the use of those faculties answerable rather than sovereign.

structural_cues: The focus closes with divine خَبِيرًا بَصِيرًا; 17:36 repeats sight among answerable human faculties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine inner-and-outer knowledge and accountable human faculties; I infer that visible provision cannot rank recipients. A live alternative is that 17:36 regulates unsupported claims generally without targeting wealth judgments.

changed_reading.before: The closing attributes reassure that distribution is known and observed.
changed_reading.after: They also establish an epistemic boundary: observers see quantities but may not infer recipients' hidden standing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the soil-and-water branch of خ ب ر beneath adjectival خَبِير. It remains anchored in earth-like spreading, rain-provision, measured amount, and nurturing lordship. Render it only as an ecological analogy, not as a replacement for the ordinary epistemic force of divine knowledge.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ وَيَقْدِرُ can be imaged as a field spread out, watered, and given a growth-sustaining measure.

activation_trace.role: Feeding and growth supply the nurturing process in the material analogy.
Broad level ground supplies the field across which provision is spread.
Rain descending as provision supplies the life-bearing input.
A quantity reaching its limit supplies the amount under which growth succeeds.
Soft earth and its water supply the branch-distant substrate of the image.

changed_reading.before: Provision is an abstract stock whose amount rises or falls.
changed_reading.after: Provision can be pictured as a cultivated ecology: ground opens, life-bearing input arrives, and its measure is fitted to growth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The horizontal-versus-vertical spatial contrast is a cross-domain inference, not an explicit gloss of provision. It remains anchored in focus expansion and limit, then in the proud walker's inability to attain mountain height. Render it as a contained warning that increased means enlarge action, not personal magnitude.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Breadth of provision can widen a servant's field of action without enlarging the servant's rank or stature.

activation_trace.role: Breadth and increase supply the abundance mistaken for personal enlargement.
A defining limit supplies the counterclaim that every recipient remains measured.
Joy exceeding its measure supplies the conversion of abundance into arrogance.
The high solid mass supplies a scale the proud walker cannot attain.
Self-exalting extension names the false vertical reading of expanded means.

changed_reading.before: Expanded provision may be experienced as expanded personal standing.
changed_reading.after: Expanded provision broadens available action but grants no warrant for self-exalting stature.

strongest_changes: The immediate hand-extension echo in 17:29 frames generous but non-depleting human mediation.
The provision echo in 17:31 prevents present constriction from becoming a zero-sum verdict against dependents.
The orphan, measure, balance, and accountability sequence makes qadr resonate as exact fiduciary allotment and limits human claims to knowledge.
summary.what_was_special: The focus lexicon links care, metrology, and epistemic authority: provision is fitted rather than merely varied, and خَبِيرًا بَصِيرًا blocks visible wealth from becoming a transparent measure of human rank.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether يَقْدِرُ should be heard chiefly as constriction or fitting to measure; both branch mechanisms remain live.
Whether the surrounding commands make divine calibration a norm for human practice or only explain human capacity.
The ecological and spatial models depend on branch-distant moves and should remain explicitly exploratory.
